_status: Implements the thesis equations s_k = clip((h_stop-h)/(h_stop-h_safe),0,1); s_phys = min_k s_k; R_T = d_out/v + T_fish + d_ret/v; M = (W-R_T)/R_T; S = G_BMD * min(s_phys, clip(M/0.25,0,1)). Vessel limits are PROVISIONAL (config/vessels.json).
route_note: Straight sea-lane from the port's sea-entry waypoint to the station, sampled every route_samples; every sample must be wet in GEBCO. If not, routing 'failed': an approximate distance is shown but the trip is never certified.
